title: Learning community norms
description: An NSF-funded project investigates how online communities can support people in learning norms and participating constructively.

funding.program: SaTC: CORE: Small: Community-Based Support for Learning Community Norms

label: Communities / Governance
longDescription: This NSF-funded project studies how online communities can support people in learning their norms. It examines peer support for users after moderation and why people break community rules, to inform community-based approaches to norm learning.
